properties.name: app.jwt.secret-key
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-time
properties.description: JWT access token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-expiration-time
properties.description: JWT refresh token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.mail.from-email
properties.description: Email address used as the sender for outgoing mail.

properties.name: app.mail.from-name
properties.description: Display name used as the sender for outgoing mail.

properties.name: app.mail.base-url
properties.description: Base URL used to build links in emails (e.g. verification links).

properties.name: app.mail.verification-expiry-minutes
properties.description: Number of minutes before an email verification link expires.

properties.name: twilio.account-sid
properties.description: Twilio account SID used for SMS/OTP delivery.

properties.name: twilio.auth-token
properties.description: Twilio auth token used for SMS/OTP delivery.

properties.name: twilio.phone-number
properties.description: Twilio phone number used as the SMS sender.

properties.name: otp.length
properties.description: Number of digits in a generated OTP.

properties.name: otp.expiry-minutes
properties.description: Number of minutes before an OTP expires.

properties.name: otp.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of allowed OTP verification attempts.
